1.synopsis: Mara Quell climbs Mount Teral, learns the Cinder Breath from Toven Rusk and reaches the Ashwalker realm.

entities.name: Mara Quell
entities.summary: A new student who climbed Mount Teral.

entities.name: Toven Rusk
entities.summary: The old man who teaches the students who reach the gate.

entities.name: Mount Teral
entities.summary: The mountain with a black stone gate at its summit.

entities.name: Cinder Breath
entities.summary: A slow breathing technique that moves heat into the body.

entities.name: Ashwalker
entities.summary: The realm a body reaches when the warmth stays in the heart.

entities.name: Pyre Sovereign
entities.summary: A figure of a hearth story whose roof the snow never touched.

facts.claim: Mara reached the top of Mount Teral.
quotes: Mara Quell reached the top of Mount Teral on the ninth morning of the thaw

facts.claim: Mara stands in the Ashwalker realm.
quotes: Mara stood in the Ashwalker realm, and she could walk barefoot over the banked fires

facts.claim: Ashwalker is the first step a body takes on the mountain.
quotes: you will stand in the realm we call Ashwalker. It is the first step a body takes on this mountain.

facts.claim: Nobody would say whether the Pyre Sovereign was a person, a title or a story.
quotes: Nobody would say whether the Pyre Sovereign was a person, a title, or only a story
He taught her the Cinder Breath that same afternoon.

2.synopsis: Toven Rusk explains that Ashwalker names both the sect and its first realm, and Mara writes her name in the sect ledger.

entities.name: Ashwalker
entities.summary: The sect of Mount Teral, named after its first realm.

entities.name: Toven Rusk
entities.summary: An elder of the Ashwalker sect.

facts.claim: Ashwalker is the name of the sect and of its first realm.
quotes: Ashwalker is the name of our sect, and Ashwalker is also the name of its first realm.

facts.claim: The sect has fourteen students and two elders.
quotes: The sect had a hall, a library with a leaking roof, fourteen students, two elders, and a goat that nobody owned.

facts.claim: Mara wrote her name in the sect ledger.
quotes: She wrote: Mara Quell, ninth day of the thaw, Ashwalker.

3.synopsis: Sefa Lind of the Glass Lantern Sect shelters on the mountain, and Mara reaches the Emberheart realm.

entities.name: Sefa Lind
entities.summary: A young woman who leads visitors from the Glass Lantern Sect.

entities.name: Glass Lantern Sect
entities.summary: A sect whose members carry clear glass lanterns that give no light.

entities.name: Clear Pane
entities.summary: A realm in which one learns to see through a thing.

entities.name: Prism Warden
entities.summary: The realm of Sefa's teacher, whose name Sefa has not been told.

entities.name: Emberheart
entities.summary: A realm in which the warmth spreads from the heart through the body.

facts.claim: Clear Pane is the first realm of the Glass Lantern Sect.
quotes: Clear Pane is the first realm of the Glass Lantern Sect.

facts.claim: Emberheart is the second realm of Ashwalker.
quotes: Emberheart is the second realm of Ashwalker, and you reached it before your first winter on the mountain.

facts.claim: Mara reached Emberheart before her first winter.
quotes: Emberheart is the second realm of Ashwalker, and you reached it before your first winter on the mountain.
The Glass Lantern Sect sends its greetings,

4.synopsis: Toven Rusk takes Mara up the Pyre Stair and tells her that the Pyre Sovereign is the third realm of Ashwalker.

entities.name: Pyre Sovereign
entities.summary: The third and highest realm the sect has written down.

facts.claim: The Pyre Sovereign is the third realm of Ashwalker and the highest one the sect has written down.
quotes: The Pyre Sovereign is the third realm of Ashwalker, and the highest one the sect has ever written down.

facts.claim: Toven's teacher's teacher was the Pyre Sovereign.

5.synopsis: Hollis Grey, a Dusk Listener, visits the mountain and brings word that the Glass Lantern Sect has closed its gates.

entities.name: Hollis Grey
entities.summary: A wandering listener with a wooden flute.

entities.name: Dusk Listener
entities.summary: A realm of those who walk and listen.

facts.claim: Hollis Grey is a Dusk Listener.
quotes: I hear it because I am a Dusk Listener.

facts.claim: Dusk Listener is the first realm of the Vesper Hollow, a sect that keeps no mountain.
quotes: Dusk Listener is the first realm of the Vesper Hollow, a sect that keeps no mountain and no hall.

facts.claim: The Glass Lantern Sect has closed its gates.
quotes: the Glass Lantern Sect has closed its gates.
I hear it because I am a Dusk Listener.
